decisions.reason: The assessment outputs and document-review coverage added to the due-diligence Requirement do not change the independently established style-system coverage Requirement.
The source Event adds proposal and assessment deliverables but does not alter any bullet-size, balance, alignment, or scaling requirement.
The assessment outputs and coverage do not change the separately established legacy copy-paste behavior, test sources, or target template version.
The source Event concerns due-diligence outputs and reviewed materials; it does not change Tab-key behavior or list-hierarchy requirements.
The due-diligence assessment additions do not alter the requirement that manual line breaks work reliably after pasted content.
The assessment deliverables do not modify the table-layout stability requirement; the same message already independently establishes and reports failure of that behavior.
